title: Database Normalization
overview: Database normalization is the process of structuring a database to reduce data redundancy and improve data integrity. This is a fundamental database concept tested in most exams.

keyConcepts.name: BCNF
keyConcepts.description: Boyce-Codd Normal Form and its applications

examTips: Expect questions asking you to identify the normal form of a given schema, normalize a table, or explain the benefits of normalization in specific scenarios.
